Container.Name: skiptro
Container.Overview: Automatic TV show intro and credits detection using audio fingerprinting. Scans your media library and generates skip markers that Kodi (via service.skiptro) can use to auto-skip intros during playback. Manage it from the built-in web UI.
Container.Changes:
[center][b]Skiptro Change Log[/b][/center]
[b]v1.4.0[/b] More seasons find their intro, new shows are matched on TMDB after a scan, and a season with no intro says why.
[u]Detection[/u] - **More seasons find their intro**: partial matches could still hide the real one. Seen on 12 Monkeys seasons 1 and 4. Reported by daveh077. - **Missed episodes found on more seasons**: seen on The Woman in the Wall. A Big Bang Theory retrospective special no longer gets a false intro.
[u]Scanning[/u] - **Scan log**: Activity shows one line per season, with Show details for the full log. A season with no intro says why: too few or unreadable episodes, no shared opening, only a title card or logo, or rejected. - **Shows stuck on "needs scanning"**: a show whose seasons were already scanned clears on the next scan. - **Shows with fewer than 2 episodes** no longer count as needing a scan.
[u]Web UI[/u] - **New shows are matched on TMDB after a scan, scheduled included.** Reported by Hitcher. - **Weekly scan schedule**: picking Weekly left the Frequency dropdown blank and was never saved. Reported by WegoW (skiptro-releases#8). - **Verify libraries**: episodes under a deleted show folder are removed when the library is still there.
[u]CLI[/u] - **`--verbose`** prints the detection detail that always goes to scan.log. - **Same library with or without a trailing separator**: `scan F:\TV` and `scan F:\TV\` no longer create two libraries. - **`scan-files --diagnostics`** lists every match between episodes, per episode.
[u]Bundled[/u] - **ASP.NET Core 10.0.13**: fixes two high severity security advisories in the web server.
[u]Docs[/u] - **Output formats and REST API**: documented in the docs folder of the public repo.
[b]v1.3.2[/b]
[u]Detection[/u] - **Whole seasons with no intro found**: short partial matches could outnumber the real intro matches and hide the intro. Seen on The Big Bang Theory seasons 10-12. Reported by daveh077.
[u]Web UI[/u] - **Season Rescan**: always rescans the season. It did nothing on a season where no intro was found.
[u]CLI[/u] - **`--no-position` removed**: it had no effect.
[u]Bundled[/u] - **FFmpeg 9.0.2** on every platform. - **FFmpeg license**: the notices state GPL version 3, and the full text ships in the ffmpeg folder.
[b]v1.3.1[/b]
[u]CLI[/u] - **`show window` takes minutes**: it asked for seconds while the web UI offered minutes, so the same setting wanted a different unit depending on where you set it. `skiptro show window "/path/to/Show" 30` now means 30 minutes.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Skiptro web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent data: scan results, library config, and database.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Path to your TV show library. Must be read-write so skiptro can write .skiptro.json files alongside episodes. Add more paths below if your media is spread across multiple shares.

Config.Name: Media Paths
Config.Description: Container paths to register as media libraries (comma-separated). Must match your volume mount targets above. If you add more path mappings, add the container paths here too.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank and the web UI is open to anyone on your network. Set a long random value to require it for access from other devices. For access from outside your LAN, use a VPN or an authenticated reverse proxy.
